name: @marianmeres/sync-versions
description: Carry a pnpm workspace's root version into every member manifest, VERSION constant and the changelog — the before-commit step of a one-version release.
author: Marian Meres

scripts.ci: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm test
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run ci && pnpm run build
scripts.release: npx --yes @marianmeres/release@^2.3.0 --before-bump "node src/bin.ts --preflight && pnpm run ci" --before-commit "node src/bin.ts"
scripts.rp: npm whoami >/dev/null && pnpm run release -y --before-push "pnpm publish"
scripts.rpm: npm whoami >/dev/null && pnpm run release minor -y --before-push "pnpm publish"
